global_clock_guard: GLOBAL FRONTIER REMAINS 1944-02-21 until Eastern Fleet 19-22 Feb overlap is adjudicated.

US_force.assault_pool: about 8,000 Army/Marine assault personnel plus attached tanks, artillery, engineers and amphibious vehicles

air_support_branch.role: CAP, CAS, pre-assault suppression, reconnaissance, ASW; HAILSTONE main carrier mass remains separate

US_force.amphibious_lift: historical-equivalent transport group, LSD Ashland, about nine LSTs and six LCIs; LST-224 loss at Kwajalein already paid and replacement/reform delay embedded in 17-18 Feb sortie

air_local_19Feb.mix: surviving land-attack/recon plus a very small local float-recon element; no fighter/Raiden detachment spawned

radar.warning: visual lookout, radio reports and aircraft reconnaissance only centered
radar.guard: Do not back-port Truk Würzburg/precision-fire-direction hardware to Eniwetok without a physical shipment trace.

20Feb_outer_islets_and_passages.Wide_Passage: existing minefield is detected; Branch fuze/QC/obstacle maintenance makes sweep slower and more cautious but does not create a hidden large field
20Feb_outer_islets_and_passages.mine_damage_upper: one small minesweeper/LCI light-to-moderate damage sensitivity
20Feb_outer_islets_and_passages.outer_islets: Canna/Camellia-equivalent artillery positions seized with little/no organized opposition
20Feb_outer_islets_and_passages.US_artillery: 75/105mm-class fires begin against Engebi and continue through the night

20_21Feb_Japanese_air.fresh_contact: YES; local visual/recon reports assault shipping
20_21Feb_Japanese_air.US_material: near-miss/splinter damage only centered; no transport mission-kill
20_21Feb_Japanese_air.remaining_air: 1-3 aircraft escape west or are grounded/destroyed during 21 Feb suppression
20_21Feb_Japanese_air.radar_fire_control_note: US shipborne radar and fighter-direction provide warning and vectoring, but night-CAP interception remains imperfect; mass surprise is denied.

submarine_ASW.Japanese_cost: one boat mission-damaged/forced off centered; no sinking center
submarine_ASW.reason: CVE air + DD/DE + lagoon entrance patrols make repeated close approaches expensive. Branch submarine cueing buys a report/approach, not a free shot.

preassault_fire_control.US: radar/optical directors give excellent area/point fire on mapped guns and beach sectors; spotting aircraft/forward artillery improve correction
preassault_fire_control.limit: radar cannot identify buried spider holes or perfectly discriminate own LCIs inside smoke/dust; danger-close fratricide remains possible later
preassault_fire_control.Japan: no confirmed local precision radar; coastal/mountain-gun fires rely optical observation, pre-registration and local communications
